title: PBKDF2 iteration count cast to int is UB if iter > INT_MAX
description:
In wp11_keystore.c ~line 914, the iter field (uint32_t read from file) is validated against WP11_KEYSTORE_MIN_KDF_ITER (100000) but not against INT_MAX. It is then cast to int for wc_PBKDF2(). Values above 2^31-1 produce undefined behavior per C99 (signed overflow). In practice no one will store >2B iterations, but an adversarially crafted .p11k file could set this field to e.g. 0xC0000000 (3GB) which cast to int becomes negative, with wolfCrypt behavior undefined.

Fix: add 'if (iter > (uint32_t)INT_MAX) return WP11_KEYSTORE_ERR_PARAM;' before the cast. Add comment explaining why.
